messages.subject: Bipartite networks in ggplot2?
parts:
Hello everybody,

I have looked for a way to graph three networks into the same panel using the facet_wrap function. However, I have not found anything. Is it possible to combine the results produced by bipartite and generate such a thing? I only have found something for combining results from bipartite and ggplot2 for food webs only: http://r-ecology.blogspot.com/2011/03/basic-ggplot2-network-graphs.html

Thanks for any comments or suggestions you might have.

Sincerely,

Paola
